row.evidence: Emma's pricing page lists single sign-on on Emma for Teams ($205/month) but no SCIM or automated provisioning on any plan, and neither the API reference nor the help-centre article index documents SCIM.
row.notes: None by absence: no SCIM or provisioning mentioned on the pricing page, the API reference (api.myemma.com) or the help-centre article index (220 article URLs in its sitemap; one SSO article, none on SCIM). Plans are flat per account, not per user: Emma Lite $105/month (5 users), Emma for Teams $205/month (25 users, SSO), Emma Corporate Contact Us (unlimited users); the page does not say whether prices are monthly or annual billing, and prices rise above 10,000 contacts. Okta's OIN Emma app is SWA-only. The public API (API access on Lite) can list account users and invite users to an HQ subaccount with a role, but has no documented deactivate or delete call for users. Help-centre articles are rendered client-side (Salesforce) and could not be read in full.

plans.name: Emma Lite
plans.notes: 5 users, 2 role types per the compare table. Flat account price.

auth.notes: Account ID plus public/private API key pair.

capabilities.notes: Invite assigns a role type only; further permissions and multiple subaccounts must be set in the web app. 'Groups' in the Emma API are audience (contact) groups, not user groups.

rate_limits.text: 180 calls per minute; 403 Rate Limit Exceeded when over.

limitations.text: Users can only be invited to a single subaccount via the API, and only the role type can be set.
